title: Tierwise manifest (tierwise.yaml)
description: Structure of the project manifest tierwise.yaml (section 1, MANIFEST, SRC and NS clauses). The schema checks shape only. Semantic checks stay in the compiler: that specVersion equals a version the compiler implements (MANIFEST-5), that a built-in preset name exists (MANIFEST-22), that path placeholders are well formed (SRC-23), that a glob resolves inside the project root (MANIFEST-12), that lint rule names are valid (LINT-10), and that engine error codes used as lint names are reported (LINT-8). Null is not an accepted value for any member (MANIFEST-7). Inline schema, values and rules content is validated against the file schemas it is written in, by $ref.

specVersion.description: The spec version the project is written against, as a string (MANIFEST-4). The only declaration of the spec version (MANIFEST-6). The compiler accepts only the version it implements, compared exactly (MANIFEST-5, MANIFEST-8). Write it quoted in YAML.

extends.description: Preset references, applied in list order before the project's own definitions (MANIFEST-19, MANIFEST-31). Each item is a built-in reference, a relative path to a preset file, or a URL reference with a SHA-256 digest (MANIFEST-20).

sources.description: Glob patterns and values entries that select the project's source files (MANIFEST-10, MANIFEST-11).

schema.description: Inline shared schema content for a single-file project. It must be a mapping and is a shared file (MANIFEST-13, MANIFEST-14, NS-3). Its top-level keys follow the schema-file rules (SRC-14), except that namespace is not allowed because a shared file must not contain it (NS-7). A value that is not a mapping is E_MANIFEST (MANIFEST-14).

not.description: Inline schema content is a shared file (MANIFEST-14, NS-3), and a shared file must not contain the namespace key (NS-7). The compiler reports it as E_NAMESPACE_VIOLATION.

values.description: Inline values content: a mapping with the multi-node shape only, one entry per non-root scope holding nodes, and an entry for the root level holding key-value entries without a node (MANIFEST-15, SRC-29, SRC-30). The flat path-mapped and root shape (SRC-25, SRC-26) is not allowed inline. The $ref points at the multiNodeFile definition, not at the root of the values-file schema, which also accepts the flat shape. A value that is not a mapping is E_MANIFEST (MANIFEST-15); any other shape violation is E_SOURCE_MAPPING (SRC-31).

rules.description: Inline rules content: a list with one rules document per feature (MANIFEST-13, MANIFEST-16). Two items that configure the same feature are a duplicate (SRC-44).

namespaces.description: Namespace names, each owning one schema file (NS-1, NS-2). Keys are namespace names. A name must not contain a dot (NS-9).

propertyNames.description: A namespace name, which must not contain '.' (NS-9).

lint.description: Lint settings: a mapping whose only key is rules, which sets the severity of lint rules (MANIFEST-37, MANIFEST-38, LINT-4).

presetReference.description: One item of extends (MANIFEST-20). Either a string (a built-in reference such as tierwise:<name>, or a relative path to a preset file, MANIFEST-21, MANIFEST-23) or a URL reference mapping (MANIFEST-25).

oneOf.description: A built-in reference of the form tierwise:<name> (MANIFEST-21), or a relative path to a preset file that does not begin with tierwise: (MANIFEST-23). The compiler tells them apart and checks the name or path.

urlPresetReference.description: A URL preset reference with exactly two keys (MANIFEST-26). The digest is computed over the exact bytes retrieved and is verified before any preset content is read (MANIFEST-29).

url.description: An https URL of the preset file (MANIFEST-26). The scheme is matched case-insensitively (RFC 3986, section 3.1).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the preset's exact bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (MANIFEST-26).

sources.description: The source lists of the project. Each key is optional and no other key is allowed (MANIFEST-10).

schema.description: Glob patterns, relative to the project root, that select schema files (MANIFEST-11, SRC-18). A file matched by two patterns is selected once (SRC-20 (b)).

items.description: A glob pattern: '/' separates segments, '*' matches within one segment, '**' spans directories (SRC-18).

values.description: Values entries, each of exactly one of the three shapes: path-mapped, root or multi-node (SRC-21). A file may be selected by only one entry (SRC-34).

rules.description: Glob patterns, relative to the project root, that select rules files (MANIFEST-11, SRC-18).

items.description: A glob pattern that selects rules files (SRC-18).

valuesEntry.description: One item of sources.values. Exactly one of the three shapes of SRC-21 applies. The shapes are mutually exclusive because each forbids the members of the others. An item that matches none of them is E_SOURCE_MAPPING (SRC-21), not E_MANIFEST, so the compiler must map a failure at this item to E_SOURCE_MAPPING.

pathMappedValuesEntry.description: A path-mapped entry (SRC-21, SRC-22). The pattern names the scope and node of each values file it selects through its {scope} and {node} placeholders. Placeholder counts and positions are checked by the compiler (SRC-23).

pattern.description: A path pattern containing {scope} and {node} placeholders, for example values/{scope}/{node}.yaml (SRC-22, SRC-23).

rootValuesEntry.description: A root entry (SRC-21, SRC-26). The file holds values for the root level. The scope names the root level (SRC-27).

file.description: The path of the root values file, relative to the project root (MANIFEST-12, SRC-17).

scope.description: The name of the root level that the file's values belong to (SRC-27).

multiNodeValuesEntry.description: A multi-node entry (SRC-21, SRC-29). The file holds values for several scopes and nodes, in the shape of SRC-29 and SRC-30.

file.description: The path of the multi-node values file, relative to the project root (MANIFEST-12, SRC-17).

namespaceEntry.description: The value of one namespace name (NS-2). Its only key is schema.

schema.description: The path of the one schema file this namespace owns, relative to the project root (NS-2, MANIFEST-12). The file is namespaced (NS-3).

lint.description: Lint configuration (MANIFEST-37). Its only key is rules. Used by the manifest and by presets (MANIFEST-36).

rules.description: Mapping from lint rule identifiers to severities (MANIFEST-38). Rule names are checked by the compiler (LINT-8, LINT-10).

lintRules.description: A mapping from lint rule identifiers to severities (MANIFEST-38). Rule names are not listed here. The compiler checks each name against the lint rules, the naming/* wildcard and the engine error codes, and reports an invalid name as E_MANIFEST or E_PRESET (LINT-8, LINT-10). An engine error code is reported as E_PRESET whatever its value (LINT-8).

severity.description: A lint severity (LINT-3). An unlisted value is reported under LINT-10 (c) with the code that LINT-10 (b) gives.
